records.name: grass
records.prompt: Use case: texture-edit. Convert the attached top-down pixel-art ground texture into a grayscale height map of the same surface, pixel for pixel in the same place. Raised parts are bright (stones, grass clumps, pebbles), recessed parts are dark (mortar gaps, bare earth between tufts, cracks). Keep the same 32×32 chunky pixel grid and hard pixel edges, at most 8 gray levels, no shading, no shadows, no new shapes, no outline, no border, seamless tileable on all four edges. Output exactly one 1024×1024 image. Input is the grass albedo; preserve every clump's position exactly.

records.name: grass-dirt_path
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A top-down, hand-painted chunky pixel-art ground patch where grass meets dirt_path along a wandering, ragged, natural border: grass on one side, dirt_path on the other, a few pixels of each poking into the other, no straight lines, no soft gradient, crisp hard pixels on a 32×32 grid per tile, same warm saturated palette as the attached textures. Input image 1 is grass; input image 2 is dirt_path, both palette and surface references. No shadows, no perspective, no border, no text, no flowers, no props. Exactly one 512×512 image.
